items.name: Runaway Bay Sunday Challenge 2022
items.information: This is a series competition alongside [Runaway Bay Saturday Challenge 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RunawayBaySaturdayChallenge2022) . You will be permitted to compete at **ONLY ONE** of the two competitions. If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each competition has a different set of events. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

items.information: * Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well.
